title: theOS's check ships at today's coverage
quote: I don't want to test it by hand: I trust the results. So it's good.
means: Gate B passes for aip-31df on the check's results, without a manual try: green on the current tree, red with page, box and size named when a page is broken on purpose (shown by avenMAIA), green again after the undo, in about two minutes. c2 passes at today's coverage: every doc page and OLD-AIP page, 97 to 98 of 123 slides and 9 of 23 Learn tabs; the rest stays in the intent's gaps. The outcome is measured over the next three sessions that change view code.
